subject: Invoice INV-9927 — AP connector check & payment timing
messages:
--- Message 1 (2029-08-23T09:12:00-07:00) ---
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Ellie Park <ellie@cloudleaf.com>, AP Team <ap-team@cloudleaf.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice INV-9927 — AP connector check & payment timing

Hi Ellie / AP team,

Following up on invoice INV-9927 for Cloudleaf Systems (attached). Per our last call, I understand you’re in the middle of an AP connector cutover which might have queued invoices. Can you confirm expected payment timing for this invoice?

Options we can accept: ACH (preferred), wire, or virtual card. If wire is easiest while your connector finishes, I’ve attached our wire instructions and a vendor onboarding form that should speed verification.

If helpful, we can fast-track an expedited wire once the vendor form is cleared — happy to coordinate.

Attachments: INV-9927.pdf (invoice)

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0189

--- Message 2 (2029-08-23T11:05:00-07:00) ---
From: Ellie Park <ellie@cloudleaf.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: AP Team <ap-team@cloudleaf.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Aug 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-9927 — AP connector check & payment timing

Jonas — thanks for the reminder and the attachments.

Short version: we are mid-migration to a new AP platform this week and a batch of invoices is pending validation on the new connector. That’s why some payments are delayed. I don’t have a final PO number yet; AP team is still reconciling vendor IDs.

Most likely earliest payment date is Wed, Aug 28 once the vendor gets a matching PO and our bank details are verified. If you can send the completed vendor form and wire instructions (masked account # is fine for email), that will speed things.

Ellie Park
Director, Finance Operations
Cloudleaf Systems
ellie@cloudleaf.com

Subject: Re: Invoice INV-9927 — AP connector check & payment timing

Ellie — appreciate the update. Attached the completed vendor onboarding form and a short text file with our wire instructions (account redacted in the email; full details in the attached text file).

If your system still needs a PO to release, can we get an estimated PO number by EOD Monday? If not, we can accept a one-time expedited wire — Laura and Ben are looped for quick internal approval if Cloudleaf can confirm a same-week wire.

Also: if virtual card makes the reconciliation easier on your side during the cutover, we can issue a virtual card payment (no extra setup) — let me know preference and I’ll trigger it.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, redwood_wire_instructions.txt

Thanks,
Jonas

--- Message 4 (2029-08-24T15:02:00-07:00) ---
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 24 Aug 2029 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-9927 — AP connector check & payment timing

Hi Ellie — and thanks for the transparency.

We can accommodate your cutover timeline. To keep services uninterrupted on our side, would Cloudleaf consider one of these fast paths?

- Expedited wire (2 business days) — we’ll issue an invoice credit of $150 if you authorise the expedited wire (covers our processing overhead). Please sign and return the attached expedite_form.pdf.
- Virtual card today — immediate; no vendor form necessary and clears faster in most cutover scenarios.

If you confirm the expedited wire or virtual card option, Ben will finalize the internal approval today and we’ll mark the invoice as high-priority.

Appreciate you coordinating the PO reconciliation — please send the PO number when available and we’ll close the ticket.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0244

Attachments: expedite_form.pdf
